resale_co.name: Certificate of Occupancy - Sale (Housing Officer's certificate of occupancy inspection)
resale_co.issued_by: City of Estell Manor Housing Officer / Housing Inspector
requirements: Certificate of occupancy whenever ownership or tenancy of a dwelling changes (City Code Section 380-72D(4))
Owner must open the home to inspection by the Housing Officer at reasonable hours
Give the settlement date and a contact person to set up the appointment on the application
State smoke/CO certificate is a separate application through the NJ DCA portal

fees.label: Certificate of occupancy for resale or rerental (with smoke detector certificate)
fees.quote: Certificate of occupancy for resale or rerental with smoke detector certificate (§380-72) | $50

fees.label: Second or more reinspection for certificate of occupancy, per unit
fees.quote: Second or more reinspection for certificate of occupancy (§380-72) | $30 per unit

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the City's Certificate of Occupancy Application, tick 'Certificate of Occupancy - Sale', list the settlement date and a contact person to set up the appointment, and submit it to the Housing Inspector at 148 Cumberland Avenue, Estell Manor, NJ 08319 with the $50.00 fee payable to the City of Estell Manor. The smoke/CO certificate is a separate application through the NJ DCA portal.
resale_co.contact_title: Housing Inspector (also Zoning Officer and Code Enforcement)

evidence.quote: Change of tenancy or ownership. From and after the effective date of this chapter, a certificate of occupancy shall be required whenever there is a change in ownership or tenancy of any building or structure used for dwelling purposes.
The owner of said building or dwelling shall open it to reasonable inspection during reasonable hours by the Housing Officer.
Request for: ( ) Certificate of Occupancy - Sale ( ) Certificate of Occupancy - Rental
Inspection Fee: $50.00 - Payable to the "City of Estell Manor"
This is in addition to the Housing Inspector's Certificates of Occupancy inspection or Rental Certificate of Habitability inspection.
Chase Farabella, Housing Inspector 148 Cumberland Avenue Estell Manor, NJ 08319 (609) 476-2692
Zoning Officer Chase Farabella (609) 476-2692 x104 zoning@estellmanor.org

resale_co.notes: Now confirmed from the City code (read in full on ecode360 on 2026-10-06): Section 380-72D(4) requires a certificate of occupancy whenever ownership or tenancy of a dwelling changes, issued by the Housing Officer after inspection, and Section 185-15 sets the fee at $50 ('Certificate of occupancy for resale or rerental with smoke detector certificate') with $30 per unit for the second or later reinspection. The City's scanned application (August 2025) also shows the $50.00 fee and a 'Certificate of Occupancy - Sale' box. The fee table wording dates from when the City handled the smoke certificate; the smoke/CO certificate now comes from the State (see fire section). The application is a scanned image, so its quotes can only be checked by eye. No lead time or validity period is published. The same form covers rentals, and the City also has a rental registration form.

requirements: Smoke alarms, carbon monoxide alarms and, for homes with solar, generators or batteries, a secondary power source identification label (the State application is now the CSACMASPSIL)
The City's CO form (August 2025) still describes the state certificate as covering a fire extinguisher

authorities.how_to_apply: Apply online through the NJ DCA Fire Safety portal (Apply Smoke Certification). The City's instructions: complete the Smoke Cert data, submit, pay, and wait for the status 'Approved-Pending Inspection'. For help email BFCECodeAdmin@dca.nj.gov or call 609-633-6132.

fire_cert.notes: NJ DCA lists Estell Manor as State enforced (S) and its July 17, 2026 list marks it 'SC' (the State issues smoke certificates). The City's own CO application tells sellers to get the fire safety certificate through the State system. Fees are the State fees under N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.9(d) ($45 / $90 / $161), now cited from the NJ Register adoption text instead of the State portal page. The City's form (2025) names the certificate with a fire extinguisher; P.L.2025, c.19 replaced the extinguisher with a secondary power source label. The directory lists (609) 633-6132; the Bureau's page lists (609) 633-6106 for Louis Kilmer.
